name: Aceratus Grammaticus
bio: Aceratus Grammaticus is one of the epigrammatists whose short poems were gathered in the Greek Anthology. Paton's index of authors gives no date for the poet.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the second volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Book VII: 138).

poems.title: Book VII, 138: On the Same
poems.author: Aceratus Grammaticus
poems.text: Hector, constant theme of Homer’s books, strongest bulwark of the god-built wall, Homer rested at thy death and with that the pages of the Iliad were silenced.
